product.name: HP KC04XL Battery
product.full_name: Replacement Battery for HP ENVY 13 & ENVY x360 13 Series
product.description: Replacement battery (Model KC04XL, Part No. L08544-1C1, Regulatory Model HSTNN-IB8K) for HP ENVY 13-AH series, ENVY 13-AQ series, ENVY x360 13-AG series, ENVY x360 13-AR series, and selected ENVY x360 13M-AQ configurations. Also cross-compatible with KC04, KC04053XL, L08544-2B1, L08496-855 and HSTNN-DB8P. 4-cell, 53.2Wh, 15.4V Li-ion/Li-polymer, rated 3454mAh. Battery connector and dimensions vary by exact submodel — please confirm your laptop's specific model on WhatsApp before ordering. Tested before dispatch, drop-in fit — no disassembly beyond the standard battery bay.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on this battery?
faqs.answer: Yes — this battery carries a 6-month warranty from the date of purchase.

faqs.question: How do I install it?
faqs.answer: It's a standard drop-in replacement — no disassembly beyond the battery bay. We can talk you through it on WhatsApp if needed.

faqs.question: Can I pay via M-Pesa?
faqs.answer: Yes, M-Pesa is accepted, along with cash on delivery in select areas.
